perf.governor.guard_explained: Memory is very low, so only one part renders at a time. This stays even at full speed: running out of memory gets a run stopped, which loses more time.
perf.governor.ignore_memory_warning: If memory runs out, the system may stop the run, and the work in progress is lost. Only do this if you know memory will free up.
perf.governor.intro: The app eases off when memory is short, on battery or when the computer is busy, and speeds back up after. Every slowdown says why.
